text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Duramente suffered an injury during training.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No, I am fine.
I have applied athletic tape, so it will not be an issue.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: The pain will probably linger for a few days, but—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: As long as we don't put strain on the injured area, it shouldn't cause any problems.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Let's get back to training.
choice_data_list: You should get some rest for now.
If we change up the menu and see how it goes...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Resting would cause that much of a delay.
If the schedule leading up to the race was thrown off drastically—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I explained that moving while favoring an injury puts strain on other parts, and that this was to prevent a chain reaction of risks.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If favoring an injury leads to even more injuries,
it'll throw off the schedule even further, huh...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
For now, as you say, I'll take a rest.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Once the break is over—I'll make up for lost time all at once.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Duramente ended up
dedicating herself to treating her injury.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I tell her that if it gets even slightly worse,
we will stop right on the spot."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's fine with me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Was my assessment too optimistic?
And to think it concerned my very own body.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me.
It seems I should indeed rest quietly for a while."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having aggravated her injury, she would have to
take a break from training for a while...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Pheeew...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Movement at this level won't affect anything.
...I'm going to run one more light lap.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Without worsening her injury, Duramente was able to make an early comeback.
